```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
library(scales)
root <- normalizePath(".")
out <- file.path(root, "reports/no_uparea_migration/er_qc_sensitivity")
refit <- file.path(root, "data/processed/17_maavara_refits")
original <- file.path(root, "data/raw/dryad_data/scaling_ER_pred")
months <- c("Jan","Feb","Mar","Apr","May","Jun","Jul","Aug","Sep","Oct","Nov","Dec")
labels <- c(with_uparea="Seven-feature local", without_uparea="Six-feature unfiltered",
            strict_exclusion="A: strict", near_zero="B: near-zero",
            maavara="Maavara published")
order <- names(labels)
theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size=12))
```

# Decision question

Can two training-only ER label treatments reduce negative CONUS respiration predictions while retaining skill on the **same physically valid held-out observations** and credible coverage, especially in headwaters? The reported comparisons are a sensitivity analysis, not a change to production outputs. A physically valid ER observation is raw StreamMetabolizer `ER <= 0`; the predicted target is positive respiration magnitude `-ER`. A prediction of zero is physically nonnegative, but the current downstream workflow requires strictly positive ER, so zero is counted separately and is **not usable coverage**.

**Summary.** Both QC variants remove negative predictions throughout the saved CONUS scaling grid while improving common-test R², RMSE, and MAE relative to the unfiltered six-predictor model. B has slightly better pooled skill and retains more training rows than A. Its CONUS ER distribution remains shifted upward from Maavara's downloaded seven-predictor predictions, particularly in the upper tail. This favors B as the next candidate to validate, while leaving the production choice open.

# Design and provenance

The local fits use the archived 70/30 row split (`random_state=24`) and the same RF settings (500 trees, `max_features=5`, `max_depth=30`, `max_samples=0.4`, `oob_score=True`, `random_state=24`). The seven-predictor baseline includes `uparea`; the other three use the same six predictors without it. A removes raw `ER>0` **from training**. B removes raw `ER>0.5` from training and maps raw `ER` in `(0,0.5]` to zero respiration magnitude. All four are evaluated on the identical 134,336 original test rows with raw `ER<=0`. Training and test rows can share sites under this original row split; no site-held-out claim is made.

The [Maavara et al. Dryad archive](https://doi.org/10.5061/dryad.c2fqz61kx) contains the published network predictions and ER notebook. The final seven-predictor notebook cell reports test Pearson `r=0.8823235`, hence **Pearson r²=0.7784948**, on its unfiltered test set. It does not give RMSE, MAE, or bias in that cell. Pearson r² is not `sklearn` R² (`r2_score`). The published forest's row-level held-out predictions were not saved locally, so it cannot be scored on the common valid-only test set. Its CONUS predictions are compared on paired network keys below. The [Appling et al. source assessment](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC6289110/) and the earlier [wrong-sign audit](../step1_er_training_distribution/ER_wrong_sign_training_audit.Rmd) explain why these training treatments matter.

```{r manifest, echo=FALSE}
manifest <- jsonlite::read_json(file.path(out,"run_manifest.json"))
cat("Run UTC:", manifest$created_utc, "\n\n")
cat("Pinned versions:", paste(names(manifest$versions), unlist(manifest$versions), collapse="; "), "\n\n")
```

# Training support

```{r support, echo=FALSE}
m <- fread(file.path(out,"heldout_metrics.csv"))
m[, model := factor(labels[variant], levels=labels[order])]
support <- m[, .(model, train_n, train_sites)]
kable(support, digits=3)
```

```{r predictor-support, echo=FALSE}
ps <- fread(file.path(out,"training_predictor_support.csv"))
ps[, model := factor(labels[variant], levels=labels[order])]
ps[, .(model, feature, p01, median, p99)] |> kable(digits=3)
```

The source split, retained row counts, and retained sites were checked before fitting; see [PREFLIGHT.md](PREFLIGHT.md). Predictor quantiles show whether A or B materially shrink the range seen during training.

The two sites absent from A's training set are `nwis_09326500` and `nwis_09327000`; both have low Appling site-minimum confidence. All 154 training rows at the first site and all 113 at the second have raw ER > 0. B also loses the first site; at the second it keeps just **three** near-zero rows, mapped to zero. Thus B's one-site advantage should not be interpreted as meaningful retention of measured respiration support at that site.

# Common held-out skill

```{r overall, echo=FALSE}
overall <- m[, .(model, n, r2, rmse, mae, bias, negative_n, zero_n)]
kable(overall, digits=4)
```

```{r skill-figure, fig.width=9, fig.height=5, echo=FALSE}
skill <- melt(m[, .(model,r2,rmse,mae,bias)], id.vars="model")
ggplot(skill, aes(model,value,fill=model)) + geom_col(show.legend=FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~variable, scales="free_y") + coord_flip() +
  labs(x=NULL,y=NULL,title="Paired skill on physically valid held-out ER observations")
```

For direct paired changes, the reference is the **unfiltered six-predictor fit**. R² uses `sklearn.metrics.r2_score`; bias is predicted minus observed magnitude, so positive bias means overprediction.

```{r differences, echo=FALSE}
base <- m[variant=="without_uparea"]
delta <- m[variant %chin% c("strict_exclusion","near_zero"),
           .(model, delta_r2=r2-base$r2, delta_rmse=rmse-base$rmse,
             delta_mae=mae-base$mae, delta_bias=bias-base$bias,
             rmse_change_pct=100*(rmse/base$rmse-1))]
kable(delta,digits=4)
```

# Where skill changes

Bins below are fixed from the **pooled common held-out set**, not separately chosen for each model. Area bins (km²) are `<=50`, `50–100`, `100–1000`, and `>1000`; flow bins (m³/s) are `<=0.1`, `0.1–1`, `1–10`, `10–100`, and `>100`. Region bands are descriptive longitude groups, not ecological regions. Season follows day of year: winter Dec–Feb, spring Mar–May, summer Jun–Aug, fall Sep–Nov.

```{r strata-data, include=FALSE}
h <- fread(file.path(out,"heldout_common.csv"))
h[, area_bin := cut(uparea,c(-Inf,50,100,1000,Inf),labels=c("≤50","50–100","100–1000",">1000"))]
h[, flow_bin := cut(discharge,c(-Inf,.1,1,10,100,Inf),labels=c("≤0.1","0.1–1","1–10","10–100",">100"))]
h[, month := as.integer(format(as.Date(doy-1,origin="2024-01-01"),"%m"))]
h[, season := fifelse(month %in% c(12,1,2),"Winter",fifelse(month %in% 3:5,"Spring",fifelse(month %in% 6:8,"Summer","Fall")))]
h[, region := fifelse(longitude < -105,"West",fifelse(longitude < -90,"Central","East"))]
pred <- rbindlist(lapply(order[1:4], function(v) {
  p <- fread(file.path(out,paste0("heldout_",v,".csv")))
  p[, variant := v]
  p
}))
pred <- merge(pred,h,by="source_row",allow.cartesian=TRUE)
score_group <- function(d) {
  a <- d$observed_er_magnitude; p <- d$prediction
  list(n=length(a), r2=if (length(a)>1 && var(a)>0) 1-sum((a-p)^2)/sum((a-mean(a))^2) else NA_real_,
       rmse=sqrt(mean((p-a)^2)), mae=mean(abs(p-a)), bias=mean(p-a), negative_pct=100*mean(p<0))
}
grouped <- rbindlist(lapply(c("area_bin","flow_bin","season","region"),function(g) {
  z <- pred[, score_group(.SD), by=c("variant",g)]
  setnames(z,g,"level"); z[, grouping:=g]; z
}),fill=TRUE)
grouped[, model:=factor(labels[variant],levels=labels[order])]
grouped[, level:=factor(level,levels=c("≤50","50–100","100–1000",">1000",
                                        "≤0.1","0.1–1","1–10","10–100",">100",
                                        "West","Central","East","Winter","Spring","Summer","Fall"))]
fwrite(grouped,file.path(out,"heldout_strata.csv"))
```

```{r strata-figure, fig.width=10, fig.height=8, echo=FALSE}
ggplot(grouped,aes(level,rmse,color=model,group=model)) + geom_point() + geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(~grouping,scales="free_x",ncol=2) +
  labs(x=NULL,y="Held-out RMSE (g O2 m-2 d-1)",color=NULL,
       title="Predictive error across setting and season") +
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=30,hjust=1),legend.position="bottom") +
  guides(color=guide_legend(nrow=2))
```

```{r strata-table, echo=FALSE}
kable(grouped[, .(grouping,level,model,n,r2,rmse,mae,bias,negative_pct)],digits=3)
```

# Paired CONUS predictions and coverage

All five variants are joined by identical COMID and month; the Maavara column is the downloaded seven-predictor prediction. The local seven- and six-predictor baseline network predictions are reused from the prior run, while A and B are newly generated. `finite & >0` defines usable reach-month coverage under the current downstream sign rule. Report missing, negative, and exact-zero separately. The source network starts at upstream area ~17.5 km² and contains no reaches `<=10 km²`. We therefore identify headwaters using stream **order 1**, and separately show the smallest available area band (`<=50 km²`).

```{r conus-data, include=FALSE}
scaling <- fread(file.path(root,"data/raw/dryad_data/scaling_dataset_Qmonth_06082024.csv"),select=c("COMID","uparea","order"))
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(scaling$COMID))
scaling[, area_bin:=cut(uparea,c(-Inf,50,100,1000,Inf),labels=c("≤50","50–100","100–1000",">1000"))]
scaling[, headwater:=order==1]
network <- vector("list",length(months))
paired <- vector("list",length(months))
headwater_month <- vector("list",length(months))
network_month <- vector("list",length(months))
for (i in seq_along(months)) {
  mo <- months[i]; vals <- vector("list",length(order))
  for (j in seq_along(order)) {
    v <- order[j]
    path <- if (v=="maavara") file.path(original,paste0("scaling_ER_pred_",mo,".csv")) else if (v %chin% c("with_uparea","without_uparea")) file.path(refit,v,"ER",paste0("scaling_ER_pred_",mo,".csv")) else file.path(out,"conus",v,paste0("scaling_ER_pred_",mo,".csv"))
    p <- fread(path)
    stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(p$COMID),nrow(p)==nrow(scaling))
    setnames(p,names(p)[2],v)
    vals[[j]] <- p
  }
  z <- Reduce(function(a,b) merge(a,b,by="COMID",all=FALSE),vals)
  z <- merge(z,scaling,by="COMID")
  stopifnot(nrow(z)==nrow(scaling))
  z[, month:=mo]
  long <- melt(z,id.vars=c("COMID","uparea","order","area_bin","headwater","month"),measure.vars=order,variable.name="variant",value.name="prediction")
  long[, usable:=is.finite(prediction)&prediction>0]
  network[[i]] <- long[, .(n=.N,missing=sum(!is.finite(prediction)),negative=sum(prediction<0,na.rm=TRUE),zero=sum(prediction==0,na.rm=TRUE),
                          usable=sum(usable),p05=quantile(prediction,.05,na.rm=TRUE),median=median(prediction,na.rm=TRUE),p95=quantile(prediction,.95,na.rm=TRUE)),by=.(month,variant,area_bin)]
  headwater_month[[i]] <- long[, .(n=.N,missing=sum(!is.finite(prediction)),negative=sum(prediction<0,na.rm=TRUE),zero=sum(prediction==0,na.rm=TRUE),usable=sum(usable)),by=.(month,variant,headwater)]
  network_month[[i]] <- long[, .(n=.N,p05=quantile(prediction,.05,na.rm=TRUE),median=median(prediction,na.rm=TRUE),p95=quantile(prediction,.95,na.rm=TRUE)),by=.(month,variant)]
  paired[[i]] <- z[, .(month=mo,
                         A_gain=sum(is.finite(strict_exclusion) & strict_exclusion>0 & (is.na(without_uparea)|without_uparea<=0)),
                         A_loss=sum((is.na(strict_exclusion)|strict_exclusion<=0) & is.finite(without_uparea) & without_uparea>0),
                         B_gain=sum(is.finite(near_zero) & near_zero>0 & (is.na(without_uparea)|without_uparea<=0)),
                         B_loss=sum((is.na(near_zero)|near_zero<=0) & is.finite(without_uparea) & without_uparea>0)),by=area_bin]
}
network <- rbindlist(network); network[,model:=factor(labels[variant],levels=labels[order])]
paired <- rbindlist(paired)
network_month <- rbindlist(network_month); network_month[,model:=factor(labels[variant],levels=labels[order])]
network_month[,month:=factor(month,levels=months)]
headwater_all <- rbindlist(headwater_month)[,lapply(.SD,sum),by=.(variant,headwater),.SDcols=c("n","missing","negative","zero","usable")]
headwater_all[,model:=factor(labels[variant],levels=labels[order])]
headwater_all[,usable_pct:=100*usable/n]
network_all <- network[,lapply(.SD,sum),by=.(variant,model,area_bin),.SDcols=c("n","missing","negative","zero","usable")]
network_all[,usable_pct:=100*usable/n]
network_all[,negative_pct:=100*negative/n]
fwrite(network_all,file.path(out,"conus_coverage_by_area.csv"))
fwrite(headwater_all,file.path(out,"conus_coverage_by_headwater.csv"))
fwrite(network_month,file.path(out,"conus_monthly_distribution.csv"))
fwrite(paired,file.path(out,"conus_paired_coverage_changes.csv"))
```

```{r coverage-table, echo=FALSE}
kable(network_all[,.(model,area_bin,n,missing,negative,zero,usable,usable_pct,negative_pct)],digits=2)
```

**Stream-order 1 headwaters versus higher orders:**

```{r headwater-table, echo=FALSE}
kable(headwater_all[,.(model,headwater,n,missing,negative,zero,usable,usable_pct)],digits=2)
```

```{r coverage-figure, fig.width=9, fig.height=5, echo=FALSE}
ggplot(network_all,aes(area_bin,usable_pct,color=model,group=model)) + geom_point() + geom_line() +
  labs(x="Upstream area (km²)",y="Usable COMID-months (%)",color=NULL,
       title="ER coverage by stream size") + theme(legend.position="bottom") +
  guides(color=guide_legend(nrow=2))
```

```{r negative-figure, fig.width=9, fig.height=5, echo=FALSE}
ggplot(network_all,aes(area_bin,negative_pct,color=model,group=model)) + geom_point() + geom_line() +
  labs(x="Upstream area (km²)",y="Negative predictions (%)",color=NULL,
       title="Physically implausible ER predictions by stream size") + theme(legend.position="bottom") +
  guides(color=guide_legend(nrow=2))
```

```{r conus-distribution, fig.width=9, fig.height=5, echo=FALSE}
ggplot(network_month,aes(month,median,color=model,group=model)) + geom_point(size=1) + geom_line() +
  labs(x="Month",y="Median predicted ER magnitude (g O2 m-2 d-1)",color=NULL,
       title="CONUS prediction distribution through the year") + theme(legend.position="bottom") +
  guides(color=guide_legend(nrow=2))
```

```{r distribution-range, echo=FALSE}
kable(network_month[,.(month,model,p05,median,p95)],digits=3)
```

```{r paired-coverage, echo=FALSE}
kable(paired[,lapply(.SD,sum),by=area_bin,.SDcols=c("A_gain","A_loss","B_gain","B_loss")])
```

# Interpretation and recommendation

```{r conclusion, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
a <- m[variant=="strict_exclusion"]; b <- m[variant=="near_zero"]
u <- network_all[variant=="without_uparea",.(negative=sum(negative),usable=sum(usable),n=sum(n))]
qa <- network_all[variant=="strict_exclusion",.(negative=sum(negative),usable=sum(usable),n=sum(n))]
qb <- network_all[variant=="near_zero",.(negative=sum(negative),usable=sum(usable),n=sum(n))]
cat(sprintf("Relative to the unfiltered six-predictor fit, A changes held-out RMSE by **%+.2f%%** and B by **%+.2f%%**. ",100*(a$rmse/base$rmse-1),100*(b$rmse/base$rmse-1)))
cat(sprintf("Across all COMID-months, the unfiltered fit has **%s** negative predictions and **%s** usable predictions; A has **%s** and **%s**, and B has **%s** and **%s**, respectively.\n\n",comma(u$negative),comma(u$usable),comma(qa$negative),comma(qa$usable),comma(qb$negative),comma(qb$usable)))
cat("**Recommendation:** Advance **B** as the provisional QC candidate for scientific review. It retains 6,251 more training rows than A, has slightly better pooled R²/RMSE/MAE and smaller absolute bias, and provides the same complete positive-prediction coverage. Its extra retained site contributes only three zero-mapped observations, so that site-count difference has little practical value. Both A and B lower RMSE relative to the unfiltered six-predictor fit in every displayed area, flow, season, and region group. The practical difference between A and B is small. Neither establishes agreement with the published seven-predictor CONUS distribution: both retain the elevated upper tail associated with removing `uparea`, and the monthly median ER is higher than the downloaded Maavara predictions. Before replacing production, decide whether that distribution shift is scientifically credible and consider a site-held-out check, because the original row-wise split shares sites across training and testing. No downstream scripts were rerun.\n")
```
